text_block_list.name: Eel Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your business! Please come 
again!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That eel was delicious. I'm so 
glad I splurged on the extra-special 
grade♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A little bone got stuck in my throat... 
*cough* *cough*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario struggled to remove the small 
bones for a while after, inadvertently 
exhausting her stamina.
